info.title: NutriAI API - SwappFit Integration Service
info.description: Production-ready OpenAPI 3.0 REST API specification for NutriAI microservice backend integrated with SwappFit.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: User registration, authentication, login, logout, and session management

tags.name: Nutrition
tags.description: User profile, onboarding, physical metrics, fitness goals, and daily calorie/macronutrient budgets

tags.name: Meals
tags.description: AI meal recommendations, dynamic meal plan generation, ingredient & dish master database search

tags.name: Food Recognition
tags.description: AI photo food recognition, vision detection, portion estimation, and custom food submission

tags.name: Chat
tags.description: NutriAI conversational assistant & contextual meal suggestions

tags.name: Food Log
tags.description: Daily food logging, history retrieval, quick macro logging, and item deletion

tags.name: Hydration
tags.description: Water logging and daily hydration tracking

tags.name: Progress
tags.description: Dashboard analytics, progress insights, weekly trend charts, logging streaks, weight tracking, and data export

tags.name: Internal
tags.description: Service-to-service endpoints used by the Swapp Backend (secured with a signed service JWT). Manages nutrition profiles, macro targets, meal plans, and AI chat for integrated users.

post.description: Creates a new user with hashed password and returns an active session token.

400.description: Validation error or existing email conflict

post.description: Verifies email and password credentials, returning a session token for SwappFit client authentication.

get.description: Returns full user account info including profile, goal, preferences, and allergies.

post.summary: Complete onboarding & calculate daily target budget
post.description: Calculates BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor) and TDEE based on physical metrics, activity level, and fitness goals (muscle_gain, lose_fat, maintain, etc.), then initializes today's target calories and macro splits.

201.description: Onboarding completed and daily targets calculated

get.summary: Get daily nutrition target budget vs consumed totals

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Target date in YYYY-MM-DD format (defaults to today)

200.description: Daily target and consumed macro metrics

get.description: Returns a brief AI-generated analysis of the user's current hydration status based on today's water intake. Falls back to a rule-based assessment if the AI service is unavailable.

data.analysis: You're at 3 glasses (750ml) — about 37% of your daily goal. Try sipping a glass with each meal to stay on track.

put.summary: Update user fitness goal & activity level

200.description: Fitness goals updated and daily target recalculation completed

get.description: Filters database meals against user allergies, scores candidate meals against remaining slot macro target, and invokes Gemma LLM to select and portion-scale the top 4 meals.

200.description: 4 AI-recommended meals with custom portion sizes

data.name: Chicken Tikka Bowl
data.aiRationale: High protein meal tailored for your muscle gain target.

get.description: Generates a full daily meal plan distributed across meal slots based on remaining macro targets.

200.description: Matching meals and raw ingredients returned

get.summary: Get detailed meal composition by ID

200.description: Detailed meal nutrition, servings, tags, and allergens

post.description: Performs strict food presence pre-validation and runs Gemma Vision AI model + 3-tier ingredient/meal DB matching.

200.description: Recognized food item with portion and macro estimates

422.description: No valid food item detected in image

post.summary: Confirm recognized portion & log to slot
Recognize photo and instantly log to slot
Submit custom user food recipe to database
Send prompt to NutriAI conversational assistant

message.example: What should I eat post-workout for fast recovery?

data.reply: A meal rich in fast-digesting protein and complex carbs is ideal. Consider 300g of Grilled Chicken with Quinoa.

get.summary: Get AI meal suggestions from chat context

200.description: Daily food log items grouped by meal slot

201.description: Food item logged and daily totals updated

200.description: Food item deleted and remaining macros recalculated safely

post.summary: Quick natural-language or direct macro log

get.summary: Fetch weekly trend graphs (calories, macros, weight)
Fetch user logging streaks and unlocked achievement badges
get.description: Calculates active consecutive logging streaks with a 1-day morning grace period and checks criteria for 12+ badges.

get.summary: Get daily hydration goal & status summary
get.description: Returns the user's daily hydration goal (glass/ml target derived from profile weight, activity level, and goals) and current progress/status, separate from meal nutrition.

post.description: Service-to-service. Recomputes the user's daily macro targets deterministically from their nutrition profile, goal, activity level, and macro overrides, then upserts today's daily nutrition row. Response uses flat 'protein/carbs/fat' keys expected by mobile.

get.description: Service-to-service. Returns the user's physical profile, fitness goal, and preferences by service subject (swappUserId).

put.description: Service-to-service. Upserts the user's profile, goal, and preferences from the Swapp Backend, recalculating and persisting today's macro targets.

200.description: Profile, goal, preferences, and recalculated targets

post.summary: Generate & return a user meal plan (multi-day)
post.description: Service-to-service. Generates a personalized meal plan for the requested number of days (default 1, weekly up to 7) using AI ranking against the user's macro/micronutrient targets, then returns the committed plan days.

refresh.description: Optional meal slot name to force-refresh for today only (e.g. 'lunch')

recentMealNames.description: Recently consumed meal names to avoid repeating

activityContext.description: Optional activity/context hints passed to the AI

force.description: Force regeneration even if a plan exists

post.summary: Send an AI chat message on behalf of an integrated user
post.description: Service-to-service. Routes a user message through the NutriAI chat engine, persisting the conversation and returning the assistant reply.

conversationId.description: Existing conversation id, or omit to start a new one

contextData.description: Optional nutrition/goal context to inform the assistant

message.content: Try grilled chicken with quinoa and steamed broccoli — about 45g of protein!

get.summary: List conversation history for an integrated user
get.description: Service-to-service. Returns the user's chat conversations ordered by most recently updated.

get.summary: Get a conversation and its full message history
get.description: Service-to-service. Returns an owned conversation with all messages in chronological order.

messages.content: Try grilled chicken with quinoa and steamed broccoli!

serviceToken.description: Service JWT signed with INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET (issuer 'swapp-backend', audience 'nutriai-service'). The 'sub' claim is the SwappFit user id.

InternalProfileUpdate.description: Payload to create/update an integrated user's nutrition profile, goal, and preferences.

macroOverrideJson.description: Optional JSON string overriding default macro percentages
